styles.name: The Igniter
styles.blurb: You start things. The room knows what you think before you have finished deciding it, and most of what you have built began as a sentence you said out loud too early.

palette.line: Flare coral is your everyday register, signal amber is what you reach for when you want the room to turn, and cinder ink is the weight that keeps the other two from burning out by Thursday.
talismans: A brass key, in the coat you actually wear
A folding knife — carried, not shown
One notebook small enough to finish
palette.lucky_days: Tuesday and Saturday — the first for starting things, the second for finishing them.

mistake_one.title: You mistake speed for certainty
mistake_one.body: Your momentum reads to you as evidence — the decision came fast, so it feels like it came from somewhere deep. Sometimes it came from nothing but the discomfort of sitting still, and the two are identical from the inside.
mistake_one.fix: Sleep one night on any decision you could explain in under ten seconds.

styles.name: The Keeper
styles.blurb: You hold. People bring you the thing they cannot put down, and you take it without comment — which is why almost nobody has ever asked what you are carrying.

palette.line: Moss sage is where you are most yourself, quarry grey is what you wear when you would rather not be read, and field olive is the one that makes a room feel like it has been there a while.
talismans: A river stone, in the pocket you use least
A wooden handle worn smooth by one hand
A key to a door you no longer need to open
palette.lucky_days: Sunday and Wednesday — the first for deciding, the second for saying it.

mistakes.setup: That one is the easiest of the five to admit to. The other four cost more, and the one running your week right now is

dna.setup: Steadiness and privacy look like one trait from outside and are two inside, and the seam between them shows
dna.trigger: in the questions you took longest on,

mistake_one.title: You call it patience when it is postponement
mistake_one.body: Waiting is a real strategy and you are genuinely good at it, which is exactly why it hides the other thing — the conversation you have been not-having for months looks identical, from the outside, to one you are wisely timing.
mistake_one.fix: Name a date for the thing you are waiting on. If you cannot, you are not waiting.

styles.name: The Feeler
styles.blurb: You read rooms before you read people, and people before they have said anything. It is the most useful thing about you and it is not free.

palette.line: Bright teal is the one people notice, deep teal is where you actually live, and riffle pearl is what keeps the other two from reading as cold.
talismans: A feather kept flat between two pages
A shell small enough to close a hand around
One ring you only take off to swim
palette.lucky_days: Monday and Friday — the first for listening, the second for saying what you heard.

mistakes.setup: That one is the easiest of the five to laugh about. The other four sit lower, and the one taking the most from you now is
mistakes.trigger: the mood you picked up and kept,

dna.setup: Depth and openness pull in opposite directions and you run both at once, and where they meet shows

mistake_one.title: You take on the room's weather as your own
mistake_one.body: You walk into a tense room and come out tense, and by the evening it has stopped being the room's and become yours. Nobody handed it to you; you picked it up on the way past, which is why you cannot find where it came from.
mistake_one.fix: After any hard room, name out loud whose feeling it was. Out loud — thinking it does not work.

styles.name: The Thinker
styles.blurb: You take things apart to understand them, including yourself, and you are the only person you have never quite finished with.

palette.line: Lens violet is the one that makes people ask what you do, paper linen is where you think best, and brass gold is the warmth that stops the other two reading as cold.
talismans: A compass that does not need to be accurate
One good pen, refilled rather than replaced
A magnifier, in a drawer you open weekly
palette.lucky_days: Thursday and Sunday — the first for deciding, the second for changing your mind.

mistake_one.title: You research the thing instead of doing it
mistake_one.body: Understanding a problem feels near-identical to solving it, and you are good enough at the first that you can stay there for months. The tell is that you can describe every option and have not started any.
mistake_one.fix: When you catch yourself on the third source, stop and do the smallest version of the thing instead.

Owl.drive: An Owl that leads with drive is uncommon — the watching is still the first thing you do, and it is over much faster than anyone expects.
Owl.anchor: An Owl that leads with anchor is a genuine cross — you watch, and then you stay, and both halves are unusual on their own.
Owl.wave: An Owl that leads with wave is rare — what you are reading is the mood of the room rather than its facts, and you are almost never wrong about it.
Owl.prism: An Owl that leads with prism runs true — you would rather understand a thing than be early to it, and you are usually both.

Fox.drive: A Fox that leads with drive runs true — you find the gap and you are already through it while the room is still describing the wall.
Fox.anchor: A Fox that leads with anchor is a genuine cross — the quickness is all still there and it now has somewhere to put things, which is why yours actually accumulate.
Fox.wave: A Fox that leads with wave is uncommon — the cleverness goes into people rather than problems, and it reads as charm from the outside.
Fox.prism: A Fox that leads with prism is uncommon — you solve things sideways, and the answer usually arrives before you can explain the route.

Wolf.drive: A Wolf that leads with drive is uncommon — the loyalty is the same and it moves first, which is how you end up leading things you never asked for.
Wolf.anchor: A Wolf that leads with anchor is a genuine cross — you are the one who stays, and the group works out much later that this was the whole structure.
Wolf.wave: A Wolf that leads with wave runs true — you belong to your people before you belong to yourself, and you feel a rift in the room days before it opens.
Wolf.prism: A Wolf that leads with prism is rare — you watch your own pack the way an outsider would, and you love them no less for it.

Bear.drive: A Bear that leads with drive is a genuine cross — the size is real and it moves, and people do not get more than one warning.
Bear.anchor: A Bear that leads with anchor runs true — you take up the space you take up, and what is behind you is safe by the simple fact of being behind you.
Bear.wave: A Bear that leads with wave is uncommon — the protection is emotional rather than physical, and you know who in the room needs it.
Bear.prism: A Bear that leads with prism is rare — the strength is in what you have thought through, and you are far harder to argue with than to move.

Stag.drive: A Stag that leads with drive is uncommon — the bearing is the same and it goes forward, which is a different animal entirely once it does.
Stag.anchor: A Stag that leads with anchor runs true — you hold your ground by standing on it, and the standing is most of what you are known for.
Stag.wave: A Stag that leads with wave is a genuine cross — the dignity is a way of protecting something soft, and the people who see that stay.
Stag.prism: A Stag that leads with prism is uncommon — you keep the high ground because the view from it is better, not because it is higher.

Raven.drive: A Raven that leads with drive is uncommon — the curiosity has an engine under it, and what you pick up tends to get used.
Raven.anchor: A Raven that leads with anchor is rare — you collect and you keep, and the collection turns out to have been a plan the whole time.
Raven.wave: A Raven that leads with wave runs true — you are drawn to the thing everyone is avoiding, and you are the one who finally names it.
Raven.prism: A Raven that leads with prism is a genuine cross — you take the dark thing apart to see how it works, which is why it stops frightening you first.

Lynx.drive: A Lynx that leads with drive is a genuine cross — the patience is real and it ends abruptly, and the timing is the whole skill.
Lynx.anchor: A Lynx that leads with anchor is uncommon — you wait where you are rather than circling, and that is a harder kind of waiting.
Lynx.wave: A Lynx that leads with wave is rare — you feel the shift in a room before it shows, and you have never been able to say how.
Lynx.prism: A Lynx that leads with prism runs true — you see far more than you say, and what you do say has usually been checked twice.

Otter.drive: An Otter that leads with drive is uncommon — the play has a purpose behind it, and you get further having fun than most people do working.
Otter.anchor: An Otter that leads with anchor is a genuine cross — you are the lightest person in a serious room and the last one to leave it.
Otter.wave: An Otter that leads with wave runs true — you move with what is happening rather than against it, and you make everything around you easier by being in it.
Otter.prism: An Otter that leads with prism is uncommon — the lightness is a working method, and you solve things by refusing to be solemn about them.

Hawk.drive: A Hawk that leads with drive runs true — you see it, you commit, and the descent is the only part anyone witnesses.
Hawk.anchor: A Hawk that leads with anchor is a genuine cross — the eye is the same and the patience is new, which makes you far more dangerous to a bad plan.
Hawk.wave: A Hawk that leads with wave is rare — the height you keep is a way of feeling the whole field at once rather than a way of staying out of it.
Hawk.prism: A Hawk that leads with prism is uncommon — you climb for the view, and the decision is made long before the dive.

Tortoise.drive: A Tortoise that leads with drive is rare — the pace is a choice rather than a limit, and the day it changes people get it wrong entirely.
Tortoise.anchor: A Tortoise that leads with anchor runs true — you arrive, always, and the arriving is worth more than any of the speed around you.
Tortoise.wave: A Tortoise that leads with wave is uncommon — the shell is there because you feel everything, not because you feel nothing.
Tortoise.prism: A Tortoise that leads with prism is a genuine cross — you are slow because you are checking, and you are checking because you intend to be right.

Horse.drive: A Horse that leads with drive runs true — you were built to go, and standing still is the only thing you are genuinely bad at.
Horse.anchor: A Horse that leads with anchor is a genuine cross — all that power, pointed at one field, which is why what you build tends to last.
Horse.wave: A Horse that leads with wave is uncommon — you read the person holding the rein before you read the road.
Horse.prism: A Horse that leads with prism is rare — you want to know where the road goes before you take it, and you take it anyway.

Cat.drive: A Cat that leads with drive is uncommon — the self-possession is the same and it now wants things, which makes you very hard to divert.
Cat.anchor: A Cat that leads with anchor is a genuine cross — you keep your own counsel and your own address, and both are non-negotiable.
Cat.wave: A Cat that leads with wave is rare — you know exactly how the room feels and you have decided it is not your problem, except when it is.
Cat.prism: A Cat that leads with prism runs true — you observe from the one seat with the best angle, and you were there before anybody noticed you come in.
